references.text: The description of the table for the bread of the Presence and its utensils (plates, bowls, pitchers, and cups) given to Moses on Mount Sinai.
Bezalel made the table for the bread of the Presence and all its utensils in accordance with the Lord's command.
The regulation concerning the bread of the Presence that was always to be set before the Lord.
The command that the bread of the Presence was always to be set before the Lord.
Solomon made the gold table on which the bread of the Presence was placed in the temple.
The letter to the Hebrews mentions the table and the bread of the Presence as part of the holy place in the tabernacle.
